```{r MULTI FS RF FUNCTION PROTOTYPE}
rf_control_function = function(df,
                               target,
                               k1,
                               k2,
                               num_repeats,
                               threshold,
                               n_top_features = c()
){
  cl = makeCluster(6)
  registerDoParallel(cl)
    
  external_perf_df = NULL
  global_perf_df = NULL
  
  external_conf_table_list = list()
  global_conf_table_list = list()
  
  external_opt_model_list = list()
  global_opt_model_list = list()
  
  
  threshold_df = df %>% filter(Conc. > threshold) %>% 
    select(-c(Conc., Replicates))
  
  num_feature_array = c(1, n_top_features)
  
  for (rep in 1:num_repeats){
    global_kfold = createFolds(threshold_df[[target]], k = k1)
    
    for (global_fold in 1:k1) {
      global_train = threshold_df[-global_kfold[[global_fold]], ]
      global_test = threshold_df[global_kfold[[global_fold]], ]
      
      external_resample = external_rf_resample(
        target = target,
        dataset = global_train,
        n_folds = k2,
        transformation = c("scale", "center")
      )
    }
  }
}
  
  
  
test_df = split_dab_df_list[[6]]
test_df2 = split_dab_df_list[[3]]
test_df
test_ctrl = trainControl(method = "repeatedcv",
                         number = 5,
                         repeats = 3
                         )
test_thresh_df = test_df %>% filter(Conc. > 0) %>% 
    select(-c(Conc., Replicates))

test_thresh_df2 = test_df2 %>% filter(Conc. > 0) %>% 
    select(-c(Conc., Replicates))

test_train = train(target_vector~.,
                   data = test_thresh_df,
                   method = "ranger",
                   importance = "impurity",
                   trControl = test_ctrl,
                   verbose = T)

test_train5 = train(target_vector~.,
                   data = test_thresh_df2,
                   method = "ranger",
                   importance = "impurity",
                   trControl = test_ctrl,
                   verbose = T)

# VarImp importance attr is a data frame by default, I wonder if I run like five models, can I use bind_cols to intelligently combine them

# if I need to enforce the each resampled uses the same number of variables.
imp_test = varImp(test_train)

imp_test5 = varImp(test_train5)
```
